sidebar.views: Accessible label of the switch between the Collections and History lists.
sidebar.collections: Tab that shows saved requests organised in folders.
sidebar.history: Tab that shows requests that were sent before.
sidebar.runRequests: Button that runs all requests of a folder one after the other.
sidebar.toggle: Button and command that shows or hides the sidebar.
history.search: Placeholder and label of the search field of the history.
history.noResponse: Shown for a history entry that never got an answer from the server.
history.sentAgo.now: Very short age label of a history entry, shown at the right of the row.
history.sentAgo.minutes: Very short age label: minutes ago, for example 5m. Keep it to a few characters.
history.sentAgo.hours: Very short age label: hours ago, for example 3h.
history.sentAgo.days: Very short age label: days ago, for example 2d.
history.sentAgoSpoken: Spoken version of the short age label for screen readers.
